verdict.rationale: In-product AI insights are a fair question for a payments product with a Dashboard, so the axis applies. However, the pack documents no in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions. Payments analytics (docs-65) offers only manual filters and period comparisons. The MCP server (docs-35, docs-63) is a building block for external agents, not an in-product feature. On-reader tip suggestions (docs-7) are fixed customer-facing prompts, not data insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
